name: domains-co-za
description: Manage Domains.co.za reseller domains, DNS, nameservers, renewals and registration through a local Windows-encrypted connection.

interface.longDescription: Inspect domains, expiry dates, availability, pricing, DNS and transfer status. Preview and execute individual DNS, nameserver, lock, auto-renewal, renewal and template-based registration changes. Credentials stay in Windows DPAPI storage; 1Password Conclave is used only for explicit setup or refresh. Independently developed by Rizonetech.
defaultPrompt: List my domains and identify upcoming expirations.
Inspect the DNS and nameservers for this domain.
Prepare a domain renewal and show me its details.
